target.title: test(gateway): lock config mutation allowlist contract
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gateway `config.patch` / `config.apply` mutations are guarded by an allowlist, but the contract was not locked in tests. A regression could silently widen or narrow which config paths agents may change.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add a focused contract test suite that exercises both the allowlist guard and the real `createGatewayTool().execute()` path for `config.patch` and `config.apply`, so future edits cannot drift without failing CI.

## User Impact

No runtime behavior change for operators. Maintainers and contributors get a stable regression gate on gateway config mutation policy.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/gateway-tool-allowlist.contract.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Gateway agent tool config mutations must reject protected paths and dangerous flags before RPC, and allow only allowlisted paths through `createGatewayTool` execution.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin), Node.js v22.22.0.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/gateway-tool-allowlist.contract.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/gateway-tool-allowlist.contract.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose
 ✓ gateway config mutation allowlist contract (12 tests)
 ✓ gateway tool config mutation execution path (4 tests)

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  16 passed (16)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** `createGatewayTool().execute()` with `config.patch` forwards allowlisted edits to RPC and rejects protected/dangerous paths before RPC; `config.apply` rejects protected wholesale replacements before RPC.
- **What was not tested:** Live gateway RPC against a running gateway instance; contract tests mock the RPC client and exercise the production guard + tool execution path.

## Tests and validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/gateway-tool-allowlist.contract.test.ts --run --reporter=verbose`

## Risk checklist

- Did user-visible behavior change? No
- Did config, environment, or migration behavior change? No
- Did security, auth, secrets, network, or tool execution behavior change? No — tests only
- Highest-risk area: none (test-only PR)
- Mitigation: n/a

## AI-assisted disclosure

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor agent)
- [x] Human-run Real behavior proof from local setup
